results.description:
These opposites don’t attract. They combust.

Jilted on local television? Check. A boss who makes Attila the Hun look like a lapdog? Check. A broken-down car on a rural road keeping her from a sanity-saving getaway? Yeah, Bellamy Blake is officially having the worst day of her life.

The cherry on top? The only person who can get her out of this mess is the hottest—and grumpiest—mechanic to ever look under her hood.

Shane Griffin never met a car he didn’t like. Too bad he can’t say the same for stranded, stubborn uptown girls in two-seater convertibles. He’ll take his simple life in small-town Pine Mountain any day, thanks. No matter how sexy Bellamy’s curves look in her designer jeans. Or how much she drives him crazy every time she lands in his path.

Which only gets worse when they’re snowed in together.

And really gets worse when the sparks flying between them don’t stick to the ones coming from her car.

But Shane is hiding a secret, and the closer he and Bellamy get, the more he’s tempted to tell her the truth. Even if it breaks her heart…and breaks him in the process.
